sourcequestion: Below is the graph of a trigonometric function. What is the period of the function? Give an exact value.
answer_verification: Maxima occur at x=pi/4 and x=pi/4+pi; minima are pi/2 later. Source marked points (pi/4,-2.2),(3pi/4,-8.5) were restored and agree with y=-5.35+3.15 cos(2(x-pi/4)).
